description: Find Pixoo devices on the local network via Divoom's cloud discovery endpoint (requires internet — queries app.divoom-gz.com). Run once during initial setup to find device IPs; set PIXOO_IP in server configuration to enable all other tools. For ongoing device control use pixoo_control_device.
name: pixoo_discover_devices

configuredIp.description: Currently configured PIXOO_IP value (absent if not set).

configuredIpFound.description: True if PIXOO_IP matches a discovered device; false signals an IP mismatch. Absent when PIXOO_IP is not set.

devices.description: Discovered Pixoo devices on the local network.

items.description: A discovered Pixoo device on the local network.

id.description: Divoom device numeric ID (informational; use ip for PIXOO_IP).

ip.description: Device IP address on the local network. Set this as PIXOO_IP.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `discovery_failed`: Divoom cloud discovery endpoint is unreachable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no devices found or IP mismatch.

title: pixoo_discover_devices
